payload.title: Residual-model consensus abstention
payload.statement: Disagreement and sign consensus across independently trained surface-free datum models can identify when E008-like signed residual action is transferable, allowing exact abstention to E006 in unstable regimes without using hidden outcomes at inference.
payload.evidence_for: E009 majority consensus improved E006 by 0.1396875674 RMSE, won all five maps, improved p90 and every registered special slice, and exact abstention worked operationally.
payload.evidence_against: The three fixed rules selected nearly identical wells, majority won only 15/25 outer cells, spatial groups 0/1 and typewell groups 2/4 regressed, nested abstention retained only 0.0367 gain, and the sign-flipped negative control exceeded its frozen cap.
payload.next_test: Do not retune consensus. Test a fresh stability-regularized wide residual model using only training-fold feature stability, with E006 fallback and full repeated/shift/negative controls.
